title: posting/posted.json — the durable per-comic posting record
description:
What got posted where/when, filled by the HUMAN after actually firing each platform (or by a later post-confirm step with per-action approval). This file EXISTING at projects/

/posting/posted.json is build-comic.md's 'posting stage complete' sentinel — it must never be created before posting is real. The bundle ships it as posted.template.json; filling it and moving it up one level is the completion act. Committed to git as project text.

comic_id.description: The site catalogue id / URL id

bundle_version.description: Which prepare_post.py bundle this record came from

prepared_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC — when the bundle was prepared

completed.description: Human sets true when every platform is posted or explicitly n/a. build-comic treats the file's existence as stage-done; this flag records whether the sweep finished.

posts.description: One entry per destination. Platform keys match studio/posting.php chips exactly.

platform_other.description: Name when platform=other (reddit, tumblr, bluesky, pixiv, newgrounds — the syndication ledger tracks eleven)

status.description: todo entries are allowed in a work-in-progress record; completed:true requires none left

url.description: The actual live post URL — the proof. An entry with no proof link is worse than no entry (runbook step 6).

scope.description: full = whole comic readable there (site, paid tier); teaser = cover/teaser pages; announcement = text+link
